Altera Use Integration Launch Heidi from inside Altera with the patient already in context, then write the finished note back to the chart for review and sign-off.

Cliniko Use Integration Seamlessly sync your schedule and push AI-generated notes straight into Cliniko using Heidi's integration.

EMIS Use Integration Connect Heidi to EMIS to sync your patient schedule, map customised note sections to EMIS sections, and push completed documentation, clinical codes, and observations from Heidi to EMIS in one click.
Halaxy Use Integration Heidi Health seamlessly integrates in your Halaxy clinical notes to automatically transcribe your clinical note content and other documentation.
Medicus Use Integration Use Heidi inside Medicus to write the note during the visit, then file it to the patient record in one click.
MediOffice Use Integration Use Heidi directly inside MediOffice to record consultations, generate clinical notes, and insert them into patient records — all within your existing workflow.
MidexPRO Use Integration Use Heidi inside MidexPRO to document consultations in real time and eliminate after-hours admin
Nookal Use Integration Heidi integrates seamlessly with Nookal, letting you push AI-generated clinical notes directly into your client’s file with one click.

Salesforce Use Integration Connect Heidi to a Salesforce clinical record. Heidi transcribes the visit, builds the note, and writes documentation back to the patient record mapped to your own data model.

Semble Use Integration Heidi integrates directly into your Semble clinical notes, allowing you to record consults, generate high-quality notes, and insert them into your letters — all within your existing workflow.
TM3 Use Integration Use Heidi inside TM3 to write assessment, progress and discharge notes while the appointment is still happening.

WriteUpp Use Integration Heidi’ AI technology integrates with WriteUpp, so clinicians can create high-quality notes in real time. That means fewer clicks, less admin, and more time to focus on patient care.
